tool.name: Add Task
tool.description: Add a task card to a Starships kanban task board (boardSlug + title, optional columnName selection and metadata). Uses latest task-board connector actions (get-task-board by slug; create-task-card by columnName).

pos.description: Optional position within the column (1-based). If omitted, server appends at end.

columnName.description: Optional column selector by column title/key/name (case-insensitive). If omitted, defaults to the first column by pos.

includeIds.description: If true, include internal ids (cardId/boardId) in the response. Default: false (lean response).

columnTitle.description: Deprecated alias for columnName (kept for back-compat).
